verdict.rationale: v0 says it creates "full-stack apps" and can "scaffold full-stack apps" (v0-probe-1, v0-docs-15). It also says it "plans, creates tasks, and connects to databases as it builds" and can "connect to backend" for data-driven apps (v0-docs-35, v0-docs-24, v0-docs-28). A community user reports building an internal app with auth, roles and export from v0 (v0-comm-1), which supports end-to-end UI plus backend generation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what backend logic is generated (e.g. API routes, server actions, data models), explicit evidence that a single prompt produces both layers rather than iterative chats, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of backend output quality.
